updatedFor: gadgets wired into the 24/7 cycle; 13 tiles added; the earlier 'open gaps' re-diagnosed
_readThisFirst: Three of the five gaps recorded on 2026-08-25 were aimed at fields NOTHING RENDERS. Grep before filling: materialsRequired, processToMake, energyNeeded, verifiedPrice, commissionRate and shortVideoExplainer appear in this file and in gadgets.json and in NO renderer anywhere on the site. The detail page reads a SEPARATE file, sections/gadgets/details/<id>.json, in the shape {model, generatedAt, ai:{...}} — see tools/fill-detail-pages.js.

fieldProvenance.whatItIs: the tile's existing `what` text, re-labelled — not rewritten
fieldProvenance.whatItDoes: the tile's existing `use` text, re-labelled — not rewritten
fieldProvenance.howItWorks: the tile's existing `how` text, re-labelled — not rewritten
fieldProvenance.materialsRequired: DEAD FIELD — nothing reads it. The rendered equivalent is section 5 'Materials Used', fed by ai.materials in details/<id>.json.
fieldProvenance.processToMake: DEAD FIELD — nothing reads it. Rendered equivalent is section 6, fed by ai.manufacturing in details/<id>.json.
fieldProvenance.energyNeeded: DEAD FIELD — nothing reads it. Rendered equivalent is section 8, fed by ai.energyRequirements in details/<id>.json.
fieldProvenance.monthAdded: on the original 18 only, derived from this file's 2026-08-05 write time
fieldProvenance.addedAt: set by /api/section-tiles/add on every tile added from 2026-08-28 onward
fieldProvenance.verifiedPrice: null, and DELIBERATELY SO. The detail template's section 10 states 'no verified dollar figures are shown — check live sources for prices' and links out instead. A hand-typed price would contradict the page's own stated policy and would rot; the Amazon search link already shows the live price.
fieldProvenance.commissionRate: null — no affiliate account exists yet. See affiliateStatus below.
fieldProvenance.links: programme + search term only; website/affiliate.json turns them into URLs. On tiles added by the cycle these are derived by deriveTileLinks() in tools/tile-taxonomy.mjs from the programmes the file already uses.
fieldProvenance.shortVideoExplainer: null placeholder — nothing renders it either

affiliateStatus.verified: 2026-08-28, in a browser, against the live renderer — both branches.
affiliateStatus.withNoId: all 18 Amazon links rendered CLEAN (no tag param); rel='noopener sponsored nofollow'; the 'ad' badge appeared only on commission programmes.
affiliateStatus.withTestId: setting programs['amazon-au'].id tagged all 18 Amazon links and left Kickstarter/Crowd Supply untouched, because those programmes have param:null.
affiliateStatus.blocker: an Amazon Associates AU account. That is an account signup and is the owner's to do, not automatable.
affiliateStatus.toActivate: paste the tracking ID into programs['amazon-au'].id in website/affiliate.json, then publish. The live site serves that file with Cache-Control: max-age=0, must-revalidate, so it takes effect for every visitor on the next request — no cache-bust bump needed. (localhost serves max-age=3600, so a local check can show a stale copy for up to an hour.)

openGaps: details/<id>.json missing for most gadget tiles — this is the REAL version of the old materials/process/energy gap, and it is what leaves 9 of the detail page's 17 sections unrendered. Resumable and idempotent: node tools/fill-detail-pages.js --domain gadgets --batch N
legacy `cost` and `eff` fields still hold the '—' placeholder on the original 18 tiles
the 13 tiles added 2026-08-28 have no photo yet; the AutoLoop photo filler generates them as gadget-<id>.jpg over subsequent passes

2026-08-28: 'PROMPT 1 §3.1 asks for NEW tiles — none added' — 13 added (18 -> 31): home battery, learning thermostat, bidirectional EV charger, AI mini PC, AI note-taking recorder, AI robot vacuum, Matter hub, self-fitting hearing aids, sleep-apnoea wearable, cuffless BP monitor, indoor air-quality monitor, neural input wristband, open-hardware handheld.

gadgets/gadgets.json was absent from ENGINE_TILE_FILES, so the 24/7 cycle had no path to this section at all — it sat at 18 tiles from creation while neighbouring domains passed 90. Now registered, with a photo source and its group list in the engine prompt.
